data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Allrecipes search, recipe details, Wikipedia origin, note in Notes), but it leaves out the servings parameter and the step that sets servings, and it never says to click "New note". It also says "top-rated" instead of the first recipe with a rating, so a builder would have to guess how to pick the recipe and where the servings value comes from.
